options.name: ag_name
options.description: Name of the Availability Group that will have the new replica joined to it.

options.name: availability_mode
options.description: Whether the replica should be Asynchronous or Synchronous.

options.name: backup_priority
options.description: Sets the backup priority availability group replica.

options.name: cluster_type
options.description: Cluster type of the Availability Group. Only supported in SQL Server 2017 and above.

options.name: configure_xe_session
options.description: Configure the AlwaysOn_health extended events session to start automatically as the SSMS wizard would do.

options.name: connection_mode_in_primary_role
options.description: Which connections can be made to the database when it is in the primary role.

options.name: connection_mode_in_secondary_role
options.description: Which connections can be made to the database when it is in the secondary role.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: By default, this command will attempt to find a DatabaseMirror endpoint. If one does not exist, it will create it.

options.name: endpoint_url
options.description: By default, the property C(Fqdn) of C(Get-DbaEndpoint) is used as I(endpoint_url). Use I(endpoint_url) if a different URL is required due to special network configurations.

options.name: failover_mode
options.description: Whether the replica have Automatic or Manual failover.

options.name: read_only_routing_connection_url
options.description: Sets the read only routing connection url for the availability replica.

options.name: read_only_routing_list
options.description: Sets the read only routing ordered list of replica server names to use when redirecting read-only connections through this availability replica.

options.name: seeding_mode
options.description: Default seeding mode for the replica. Should remain as the default otherwise manual setup may be required.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: How many seconds an availability replica waits for a ping response from a connected replica before considering the connection to have failed.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: sql_instance_replica
options.description: The SQL Server instance where of the replica to be configured.

options.name: sql_password
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_password_replica
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication for the secondary replica.

options.name: sql_username
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_username_replica
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication for the secondary replica.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).
